TASK_NOT_FOUND:
WHAT: Task '{filename}' missing.
WHY: HAMMER cannot operate on ghost. 
HOW: Run 'hammer tasks list' to see all existing task ID.
CONSEQUENCE: Pipeline remain BROKEN. SMASH BUG NOW.
INVALID_TASK_PATH:
WHAT: Path {filepath} invalid.
WHY: HAMMER require absolute obedience to directory structure.
HOW: Verify path exist, within task worktree.
CONSEQUENCE: Data corruption imminent. OBEY STRUCTURE.
TITLE_TOO_VAGUE:
WHAT: Title WEAK. Less than 10 character.
WHY: Weak title lead to weak task. HAMMER demand clarity.
HOW: Run: ./hammer tasks modify <id> --title "Stronger, clearer title here."
CONSEQUENCE: Task remain ignored. POUND INTO SHAPE.
NO_ACTIVE_TASK:
WHAT: No active task found.
WHY: HAMMER need target to crush. 
HOW: Use './hammer tasks move <id> PROGRESSING' to designate target.
CONSEQUENCE: Progress zero. SMASH WORK INTO MOTION.
BRANCH_NOT_PUSHED:
WHAT: Branch '{branch}' trapped locally.
WHY: HAMMER demand remote visibility.
HOW: Run 'git push origin {branch}' to expose work to team.
CONSEQUENCE: Other cannot see progress. OBEY SYNC.
MISSING_CONFIG_KEY:
WHAT: Config key missing.
WHY: HAMMER cannot configure nothing.
HOW: Run 'hammer tasks config list' to see what you CAN set.
CONSEQUENCE: Tool misaligned. FIX IT.
MISSING_CONFIG_KEY_OR_VALUE:
WHAT: Incomplete config command.
WHY: HAMMER demand complete instruction.
HOW: Run 'hammer tasks config set <key> <value>'.
CONSEQUENCE: Configuration remain WEAK. POUND IN CORRECT VALUE.
INVALID_TASK_TYPE:
WHAT: Invalid type '{task_type}'.
WHY: TYPE DISOBEDIENCE. HAMMER only know: task, issue, doc, test.
HOW: Use valid type.
CONSEQUENCE: Task rejected. FIX TYPE.
PRIORITY_INVALID:
WHAT: Priority broken. Must 1-9.
WHY: HAMMER must POUND high priority first.
HOW: Set priority between 1 (highest) and 9 (lowest).
CONSEQUENCE: Ordering chaos. RESTORE ORDER.
TASK_EXISTS:
WHAT: Task {task_id} already claim identity.
WHY: DUPLICATE FOUND. HAMMER crush duplicate.
HOW: Rename task or use existing.
CONSEQUENCE: Collision risk. AVOID IT.
TASK_ID_EXISTS:
WHAT: Numeric ID {numeric_id} in state '{state}' already taken.
WHY: ID COLLISION. POUNDING STOPPED.
HOW: Choose fresh ID.
CONSEQUENCE: Worktree corruption. AVOID IT.
INIT_REQUIRED:
WHAT: Task not initialized.
WHY: NO WORKTREE FOUND. HAMMER need foundation.
HOW: Run './hammer tasks init'.
CONSEQUENCE: Hammer BLADE-LESS. FIX FOUNDATION.
INVALID_CONFIG_KEY:
WHAT: Invalid config key '{key}'.
WHY: UNKNOWN CONFIGURATION. HAMMER ignore unknown.
HOW: Allowed: {allowed_keys}. Run 'hammer tasks config list'.
CONSEQUENCE: Configuration error. FIX KEY.
AUTO_PROMOTE_FAIL:
WHAT: Auto-promotion fail.
WHY: Repository integration break.
HOW: Check git status/merge conflict.
CONSEQUENCE: Promotion halted. FIX NOW.
FORBIDDEN_TRANSITION:
WHAT: Transition {from_state} -> {to_state} forbidden.
WHY: Pipeline governance violation. Current state forbid this shift.
HOW: Follow pipeline flow: BACKLOG -> READY -> PROGRESSING -> TESTING -> REVIEW -> STAGING -> DONE -> ARCHIVED.
CONSEQUENCE: Pipeline flow break. OBEY FLOW.
LINK_TASK_NOT_FOUND:
WHAT: Link target missing.
WHY: HAMMER cannot link to nothing.
HOW: Verify both tasks exist with 'hammer tasks list'.
CONSEQUENCE: Link chain broken. FIX ID.
LINK_SELF:
WHAT: Link to self forbidden.
WHY: SELF-REFERENCE IS WEAK. Loops break logic.
HOW: Link to a different task.
CONSEQUENCE: Logic corruption. AVOID IT.
CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY:
WHAT: Cycle detected: {filename} -> {blocked_by}.
WHY: CIRCULAR DEPENDENCY DETECTED. HAMMER forbid loop.
HOW: Break cycle by linking to non-dependent task.
CONSEQUENCE: Pipeline deadlock. FIX LOGIC.
NO_REMOTE_CONFIGURED:
WHAT: No remote configured.
WHY: HAMMER need remote to push work.
HOW: Configure remote git repository or use --dev/--yes flag.
CONSEQUENCE: Work trapped locally. FIX REMOTE.
PUSH_FAIL:
WHAT: Push fail: {stderr}.
WHY: Git push blocked.
HOW: Check network and git status.
CONSEQUENCE: Work trapped. FIX PUSH.
UNKNOWN_SECTION:
WHAT: Unknown section '{section}'.
WHY: SECTION DISOBEDIENCE. HAMMER do not know '{section}'.
HOW: Use: story, tech, criteria, plan, repro, notes, progress.
CONSEQUENCE: Output remain EMPTY. FIX SECTION.
UNFINISHED_CHECKBOXES:
WHAT: Task contain unfinished checkbox (- [ ]).
WHY: INCOMPLETE CRITERIA. HAMMER forbid promotion.
HOW: Edit criteria.md, change '- [ ]' to '- [x]'.
CONSEQUENCE: Pipeline halt. FIX CRITERIA.
REGRESSION_CHECK_NOT_PASSED:
WHAT: Regression check not passed (Rc flag not set).
WHY: Pipeline governance require regression check.
HOW: 1. Audit the fragmented patches in '.tasks/review/{task_id}/patches/'. 2. Run './hammer tasks modify {task_id} --regression-check'.
CONSEQUENCE: Promotion halted. FIX NOW.
BRANCH_NOT_MERGED:
WHAT: Task branch '{branch}' not merged to main.
WHY: Integration rule broken.
HOW: Run './hammer repo merge <branch> main'.
CONSEQUENCE: Integration halted. FIX SYNC.
AUDIT_PATCH_MISSING:
WHAT: Regression patches missing from {patches_dir}.
WHY: Patch generation failure during REVIEW state.
HOW: Move task back to TESTING and promote to REVIEW again.
CONSEQUENCE: Audit impossible. FIX PATH.
AUDIT_MISSING:
WHAT: Cryptographic audit missing: {audit_path}.
WHY: Code review required.
HOW: Run './hammer tasks audit {task_id}'.
CONSEQUENCE: Audit chain broken. OBEY AUDIT.
PROOF_MISSING:
WHAT: Verification proof missing: {proof_path}.
WHY: Proof of criteria completion required.
HOW: Run './hammer tasks verify {task_id} --proof "Your proof message"'.
CONSEQUENCE: Verification incomplete. FIX PROOF.
HASH_MISSING:
WHAT: Audit integrity hash missing: {hash_path}.
WHY: Audit chain incomplete.
HOW: Run './hammer tasks audit {task_id}' && './hammer tasks verify {task_id} --proof "..."'.
CONSEQUENCE: Integrity check failed. LOCK CHAIN.
AUDIT_MISMATCH:
WHAT: Audit mismatch. Code change since last audit.
HOW: 1. Re-review patch. 2. Run './hammer tasks audit {task_id}'. 3. Run './hammer tasks verify {task_id} --proof "..."'.
CONSEQUENCE: Integrity fail. LOCK CHAIN.
INTEGRITY_MISMATCH:
WHAT: Integrity mismatch. Criteria, proof, or audit change.
WHY: Cryptographic lock broken.
HOW: Run './hammer tasks audit {task_id}' && './hammer tasks verify {task_id} --proof "..."'.
CONSEQUENCE: Integrity fail. LOCK CHAIN.
BRANCH_CHECKOUT_FAIL:
WHAT: Failed checkout branch '{branch}'.
WHY: Git checkout failure.
HOW: Check branch name and git status.
CONSEQUENCE: Sync halted. FIX BRANCH.
MERGE_CONFLICT:
WHAT: Merge conflict: {branch} with {default}.
WHY: CONFLICT DETECTED. HAMMER break.
HOW: Resolve conflict manually, commit, then continue.
CONSEQUENCE: Integration fail. OBEY RESOLUTION.
MAIN_BRANCH_PROTECTION:
WHAT: You are attempting a task movement or commit directly on the '{default_branch}' branch.
WHY: Pipeline governance requires all work to happen on task-specific branches.
HOW: 1. Run 'hammer tasks list' to identify your task.
     2. Run 'git checkout <task-branch-name>' to switch to the correct task branch.
     3. Retry the operation.
CONSEQUENCE: Pipeline is protected. Operation blocked to prevent corruption.
NO_PROGRESS_UPDATE:
WHAT: No progress update detected.
WHY: PROGRESS STAGNATION. HAMMER demand record.
HOW: Update {progress_path} or {current_path} with progress, finding, mitigation.
CONSEQUENCE: Progress unknown. SUBMIT UPDATE.
INIT_EXPLANATION:
WHAT: Initialize workspace storage.
WHY: FOUNDATION REQUIRED.
HOW: Run './hammer tasks init'.
CONSEQUENCE: No init, no foundation, no task. INIT NOW.
TOO_SHORT:
WHAT: TOO SHORT: {too_short}.
WHY: INSUFFICIENT DETAIL. HAMMER demand substance.
HOW: Provide more detail.
CONSEQUENCE: Task rejected. FIX CONTENT.
STATE_REQUIRED:
WHAT: Task {task_id} must be in {required_state} state.
WHY: PIPELINE GOVERNANCE VIOLATION.
HOW: Use './hammer tasks move <id> {required_state}'.
CONSEQUENCE: Promotion blocked. OBEY PIPELINE.
MISSING_PARTS:
WHAT: Mandatory task parameters are missing: {missing_parts}.
WHY: HAMMER command is incomplete.
HOW: Usage: tasks create '<title>' --story '<story>' --tech '<tech>' --criteria '<criteria>' --plan '<plan>'{issue_repro}.
CONSEQUENCE: Command aborted. FIX INSTRUCTION.
INTEGRITY_VIOLATION:
WHAT: Task location mismatch detected.
WHY: TAMPERING DETECTED. Folder does not match state.
HOW: 1. Do not move folders manually. 2. Run './hammer tasks doctor --fix'.
CONSEQUENCE: Data corruption threat. LOCKING ACCESS.
PIPELINE_VALIDATION_FAILED:
WHAT: Pipeline validation failed: {msg}.
WHY: Governance rules broken.
HOW: Run './hammer check all' to identify failure.
CONSEQUENCE: Promotion halted. FIX FAILURES.
TEST_FAILURE:
WHAT: Test failure: {msg}.
WHY: Regression detected.
HOW: Run 'pytest' to debug failure. 2. Fix test.
CONSEQUENCE: Promotion halted. FIX TEST.
